simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֱוִיל מְרֹדַךְ (H192) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֱוִיל מְרֹדַךְ (ʼĔvîyl Mᵉrôdak) means Evil-Merodak , a Babylonian king First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 25 27.

definitions.full: H192. Evil Merodak מְרֹדַךְ אֱוִיּל proper name, masculine (Babylonian Avêl (Amêl) Maruduk, man of Merodach ) son & successor of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, B.C. 562-60, 2Kin 25:27 (see COT) = Jer 52:31 . I. אול ( be foolish , compare יאל , & Arabic grow thick (of fluids)).
definitions.rootNote: of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodak;
